summary: Defines the revised IDNA protocol for registering and looking up internationalized domain names without changing the DNS itself. It is meant only for domain names, not free text. It is a Proposed Standard that replaced RFC 3490 and RFC 3491.

eli5.summary: Computers only understand a simple alphabet for website names. This gives a trick for turning names in any language into that simple form, so the old system still works.

questions: how are internationalized domain names encoded
